DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Her last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants the rewrite date, the new mark in before December 1, and the zero off the gradebook tonight; that is the fair outcome, and her time did not run out.

What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home, then gave her dated documents she could check herself, the version history with its times and a quotation that is nowhere in the play, so she could not dismiss them.

What cost ground: Nothing, because you never led with the detector, never accused Owen of anything beyond what the documents showed, and never asked her to keep quiet.

What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its edits late on the night of October 28, came closest to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: When she asked who supervises the rewrite and when the new mark goes in, you answered with the procedure alone, so have a date and a supervisor ready before she has to ask.
